note: Apple's MacBook Pro event spills into its second day, and the Mexico City GP title picture sharpens this weekend.

front.title: Apple unveils MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display
front.tldr: Apple's new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro brings a touchscreen tandem OLED display to the Mac for the first time, starting at $2,899, with battery life unchanged at up to 24 hours.

front.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Carbon, its next frontier model
front.tldr: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Carbon, the latest entry in its Gemini line, as AI labs keep up a rapid pace of frontier model launches.

front.title: Tatum's buzzer-beater and 40 points lift Celtics past Nets in overtime
front.tldr: Jayson Tatum scored 40 points and hit the game winner as the Celtics beat the 0-3 Nets 125-124 in overtime on the second night of a back-to-back, their 39th win under Joe Mazzulla.

stories.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
stories.tldr: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial OpenAI arrangements, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter to 30 September, underlining how central the partnership remains.

stories.title: Anthropic launches tools to show companies what their AI spending buys
stories.tldr: Anthropic has introduced tools letting companies track how they spend on its models, giving customers more visibility ahead of the firm's planned IPO.

stories.title: Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
stories.tldr: Google is launching a developer platform letting businesses bring their services into Gemini and Search, aiming to reshape how people discover and use apps through AI.

stories.title: October marks an inflection point for vibe-coded game development
stories.tldr: Simon Willison argues October 2026 looks like the inflection point for AI-built games, mirroring how November 2025's model upgrades transformed coding agents.

stories.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
stories.tldr: Cloud security startup Upwind raised a $400 million Series C at a $3.8 billion valuation, choosing independence over an acquisition offer from Datadog at the same price.

stories.title: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
stories.tldr: Nvidia has released a free speech-to-text model that transcribes up to 40 languages, though it works only on recordings rather than live audio, a step for meeting and medical transcription tools.

stories.title: Reddit embraces the 'For You' feed
stories.tldr: Reddit is rolling out a For You feed that blends posts from communities users have joined with personalised recommendations, following other platforms toward algorithmic discovery.

stories.title: Sony's new see-through DualSense controllers let you game like it's 1999
stories.tldr: Sony is releasing transparent DualSense controllers and matching PS5 console covers, echoing the clear-plastic look of 1990s consoles.

stories.title: Ternus addresses Apple breaking the touchscreen Mac taboo
stories.tldr: In an interview with Wired, Apple executives John Ternus, Johny Srouji and Greg Joswiak discussed the decision to finally bring touch to the Mac after years of resisting it.

stories.title: MacBook Pro with Touch is a Mac for the iPad generation
stories.tldr: Federico Viticci reflects on Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro, having used touch on the iPad since 2015, and on how the Mac has finally caught up.

stories.title: Adding touch didn't cost the MacBook Pro any battery life
stories.tldr: Despite the switch to an OLED touch display, the new MacBook Pro still offers up to 24 hours of battery life, matching the previous mini-LED models.

stories.title: Siri AI expands to more languages in OS 27.2
stories.tldr: Apple's overhauled Siri AI, released with the 27.2 software updates, is expanding to more languages as part of its push to make the assistant more conversational and personal.

stories.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping reactions call it the franchise's Rogue One
stories.tldr: Early reactions to The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping call the prequel a near-perfect adaptation, with particular praise for Joseph Zada's performance as young Haymitch.

stories.title: Giancarlo Esposito and John Turturro break character to cry mid-scene
stories.tldr: Esposito discusses his new film The Only Living Pickpocket in New York with Turturro, and reveals he has already conceived a Breaking Bad prequel centred on Gus Fring.

stories.title: Cate Blanchett warns against 'unthinking certainty' accepting Japan's Praemium Imperiale
stories.tldr: The two-time Oscar winner accepted one of the art world's most prestigious prizes and will take part in the Tokyo International Film Festival this week.

stories.title: David Bruckner set to direct Smile 3
stories.tldr: Hellraiser director David Bruckner will take over Smile 3 from franchise creator Parker Finn, who developed the story and remains involved as producer.

stories.title: An ordinary night at TD Garden, until Jayson Tatum had other plans
stories.tldr: A feature on the Celtics' overtime win over the Nets, in which Tatum's late heroics turned what looked like a routine night into their 39th win of the season under Joe Mazzulla.

stories.title: Patriots announce date for Rob Gronkowski's Hall of Fame induction
stories.tldr: Rob Gronkowski, the most productive tight end in NFL history, will be inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame on 7 November at Patriot Place.

stories.title: What are the Patriots' top needs approaching the NFL trade deadline?
stories.tldr: With a playoff spot in sight, the Patriots are weighing what they can add before the trade deadline to strengthen their roster for the stretch run.

stories.title: Sergio Perez signs new Cadillac contract through 2029
stories.tldr: Sergio Perez has signed a multi-year extension to stay at Cadillac until at least 2029, days before he starts his 300th grand prix at home in Mexico.

stories.title: FIA to use AI to help shape future F1 regulations
stories.tldr: The FIA has signed a partnership with Amazon Web Services to use AI in drawing up the rules for Formula 1's next era of cars.

stories.title: The moments that made the 2026 Red Sox: the Scottish invasion of Fenway
stories.tldr: As part of a season review, Over the Monster looks back at one of 2026's strangest and most memorable moments at Fenway Park.

read.why: On a day stuffed with big product launches, Deb Liu's account of how a landmark feature actually got built and shipped is worth your time.
read.title: The inside story of Facebook Marketplace
read.subtitle: A guest post by Deb Liu

listen.why: Edwin Land was one of Steve Jobs's heroes, and his story of inventing and launching a breakthrough hardware product echoes today's MacBook Pro event.
listen.title: #264 The Story of Edwin Land and Polaroid

listen.why: Today's new episode: how Kenn Ricci built a small Cleveland charter company into Flexjet, the world's largest Gulfstream operator.
listen.title: From a $27,500 Charter Company to a $4 Billion Private Jet Giant | Kenn Ricci, Flexjet

listen.why: A look back at Apple's biggest acquisition ever, fitting on a day Apple unveiled its biggest MacBook Pro redesign in years.
listen.title: Apple - Beats

finally.title: Norman Foster creates his first watch, in collaboration with Lebond
finally.tldr: The architect has designed his first watch with British brand Lebond, saying the process felt very similar to architecture.
